# Generational Wealth

> Generational Wealth is a disciplined swing & scalp trading community — a private Discord room where members get real-time trade callouts with defined entries, targets and invalidation, daily market commentary, and a risk-first system built to keep traders in the game. Membership is $120/month, billed via Patreon, cancel anytime.

Site: https://gwhlds.com
Operated by: Generational Wealth Holdings Corp.

**Important:** Generational Wealth is an educational trading community. It is NOT a registered broker-dealer, investment adviser, or signal-selling service, and it does not manage money or guarantee returns. All content is educational only.

## What Generational Wealth actually is

- A **private Discord community** for day, swing and scalp traders across forex, futures and equities.
- Every callout ships with a **clear entry level, defined upside targets, and a written invalidation point** — so the risk-to-reward is on the table before you enter.
- The room runs one **risk-first system**: position size comes from a fixed risk rule, not conviction. Losses stay small; winners are allowed to run.
- Members range from complete beginners to full-time traders. The education is the product as much as the callouts are.

## The Method — the three principles under every trade

1. **Break & hold.** We never chase. Price has to break clean through the called level *and hold* as the candle closes before anyone enters. Confirmation first, every single time.
2. **Know your next.** Every callout ships with a clear entry level, defined upside targets, and the next level price aims for — a plan before you click buy.
3. **Trail & protect.** As targets print one by one, the stop trails behind them to protect the gain. Profit that is given back was never profit.

## Membership

- **Price:** $120 per month, billed through Patreon.
- **Join:** https://www.patreon.com/Generational_Wealth/join
- **Cancel:** anytime, directly through Patreon.
- **Includes:** private Discord access, real-time callouts with levels, daily commentary and breakdowns, and the risk-first education system.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Generational Wealth?**
A private, membership-based swing and scalp trading community on Discord. Members receive real-time trade callouts with defined entries, targets and invalidation levels, plus daily market commentary and education built around a risk-first system.

**How much does it cost?**
$120 per month, billed via Patreon. There is no long-term contract and members can cancel at any time.

**Is this financial advice?**
No. Generational Wealth Holdings Corp. is not a registered broker-dealer or investment adviser. Everything published is educational only and is not a recommendation to buy, sell or hold any instrument. Trading carries substantial risk of loss.

**Do I need experience to join?**
No. The room is built for beginners through advanced traders. New members are taught the same risk-first process the experienced members run, starting with position sizing and invalidation.

**What markets does the room trade?**
Primarily forex and futures, with equities setups as they appear. The method — break and hold, defined targets, trailing protection — is applied the same way across all of them.

**Is it day trading or swing trading?**
Both. It is a swing *and* scalp room. Some setups are intraday scalps; others are held for days. Both are sized from the same risk rule.

**Are results guaranteed?**
No. No trading community can guarantee results, and Generational Wealth does not. Every trade a member takes is their own decision and their own risk.
